LESSON: TARAWEEH AND WITR

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Strand 2
Topic 2.2: Taraweeh and Witr
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Taraweeh and Witr, part of Strand 2 in Grade 5 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

Key inquiry question: how they perform Taraweeh/witr prayers. What is the significance of performing swalatul Taraweeh and witr?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. watch a video on the performance of swalatul Taraweeh and witr through digital devices and discuss the procedure of performing the prayer,

2. demonstrate/role-play swalatul Taraweeh and witr in class,

3. discuss the importance of performing swalatul Taraweeh and witr and present in class,

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. watch a video on the performance of swalatul Taraweeh and witr through digital devices and discuss the procedure of performing the prayer,
2. demonstrate/role-play swalatul Taraweeh and witr in class,
3. discuss the importance of performing swalatul Taraweeh and witr and present in class,
4. keep personal logs for a week on

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Taraweeh and Witr together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Communication and collaboration: the skills of listening, speaking and teamwork enhanced as learners discuss the

importance of performing swalatul Taraweeh and witr and present in class,

• Self-efficacy: the skill of executing a task is enhanced as learners demonstrate/role-play swalatul Taraweeh and witr in class.

Values:
Responsibility as learners take roles to demonstrate swalatul Taraweeh and witr in class.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Self-esteem when demonstrating swalatul Taraweeh and witr in class.

Links to other Learning Areas:
Learners able to relate to concept of even and odd number in mathematics as they demonstrate swalatul Taraweeh and witr.
